description: Calculate pips, pip value in USD and profit/loss for a forex trade on major USD pairs, long or short.

faqs.a: A pip is 0.0001 for most pairs and 0.01 for JPY pairs. Pips moved = |exit − entry| ÷ pip size.
For pairs quoted in USD (EURUSD…), one pip per standard lot = $10. For USD/JPY style pairs it is converted: pip size × 100,000 × lots ÷ exit price.
faqs.q: How is pip value in USD found?

faqs.a: Long profits when the exit is above entry; short profits when it is below. The sign of (exit − entry) × direction gives the P/L sign.
faqs.q: How do long and short differ?

howto: Pick a currency pair, lot size and trade direction (long/short).
Enter your entry and exit prices.
Read pip count, pip value and profit/loss.
